title: 序章5 狮女重伤序章6 计划救治
content_zh:
非常奇特的音乐风格，和马尔提雅人完全不同。
给黎木的感觉，反而更像是地球的摇篮曲。
反正离自己的牢房不远，顺着声音，黎木小心翼翼的探过脑袋。
瀑布般的丝柔碧蓝长发垂落在宝玉般的双肩上，闪耀着微弱的光芒。
眼睛如海洋深邃，透射出纯洁和神秘的光芒。
面容甜美而迷人，皮肤像珍珠般洁白。
体态轻盈而柔软，像水中的花朵，又像是大自然的艺术品。
悠远且纯粹的嗓音，无法用寻常言语去形容。
“这人鱼...”
看惯了妖怪似的妆容和高P，如今再看如此自然纯粹的美，黎木不可避免的被惊艳到了。
如果不是她待在监狱中，而是好好打扮一番，根本不敢想象多美。
当然，哪怕在监狱中，也只是给她多添了一份凄美与悠远。
“看来，这个世界也存在大海之类的...”
黎木不自禁的思考起来。
“谁！
？”
突然间，歌声终止，人鱼少女朝着黎木的方向看了过来。
黎木躲闪不及，被看到半张脸，索性也不逃了。
背过身去，靠在墙上解释道：“不好意思，好久没听到这样的歌了，不自觉的多听了一会儿，打扰你了很抱歉。”
然而人鱼似乎并不在乎黎木如何解释，因为她也听不懂，只能感受到情绪。

游动下半身，靠近了铁栅栏，精致的小鼻子轻轻嗅了嗅：“好熟悉的味道，你是新兰人嘛？不，又不一样...”
黎木听下来，这名人鱼少女嘴里叽叽咕咕的，也不知道在说什么，但似乎并不是那么排斥自己。
短暂的沉默后，人鱼少女又默默回到了牢房深处，眼神有些黯淡。
黎木也并不打算久留。
因为这人鱼少女哪怕白天也被关在牢里，指不定有什么危险。
而且长得太犯规，一直盯着有种摄人心魄的感觉，现在自己这情况，祸水还是避开的好。
就这样，短暂的相遇后，黎木又回到了自己的牢房。
“嗯？被那个魅魔带走，竟然跟没事人一样？”
刚踏进牢房，深处就传来了狮女的声音，似乎轻柔了不少。
黎木没敢看对方，悻悻地笑了笑，找了块角落坐了下来，今天的放风算是结束了。
监狱一天只提供两顿饭。
早上一顿，晚上一顿。
早上出去打饭，晚上牢房送饭。
content_en:
A very peculiar musical style, completely different from that of the Martians.
It felt more like the lullaby of the earth to Li Mu.
Anyway, it was not far from his cell. Following the voice, Li Mu cautiously reached his head.
The waterfall-like silky blue hair hangs down on the jade-like shoulders, shining with a faint light.
The eyes are as deep as the ocean, transmitting pure and mysterious light.
Her face was sweet and charming, and her skin was as white as pearls.
The body is light and soft, like flowers in the water, and like a work of art from nature.
The distant and pure voice cannot be described in ordinary words.
"This mermaid..."
Being used to seeing monster-like makeup and high profile, now seeing such natural and pure beauty, Li Mu was inevitably stunned.
If she hadn't been in prison and had dressed up properly, I couldn't imagine how beautiful she would be.
Of course, even in prison, it only adds an extra layer of poignancy and remoteness to her.
"It seems that there is something like the sea in this world..."
Li Mu couldn't help but think.
"Who!
? "
Suddenly, the singing stopped, and the mermaid girl looked in Li Mu's direction.
Li Mu couldn't dodge, and half of his face was seen, so he simply didn't run away.
Turning his back, he leaned against the wall and explained: "Sorry, I haven't heard a song like this for a long time. I listened to it for a while unconsciously. I'm sorry to bother you."
However, the mermaid didn't seem to care about Li Mu's explanation, because she couldn't understand it and could only feel the emotions.
He swam his lower body, got close to the iron fence, and sniffed gently with his delicate little nose: "It smells so familiar. Are you from Newland? No, it's different..."
Li Mu heard that the mermaid girl was mumbling and didn't know what she was talking about, but she didn't seem to reject him that much.
After a brief silence, the mermaid girl silently returned to the depths of the cell, her eyes a little dim.
Li Mu didn't plan to stay long either.
Because this mermaid girl is locked up in a prison even during the day, there may be some danger.
Moreover, he looks too foul, and it feels breathtaking to stare at him all the time. In my current situation, it is better to avoid the trouble.
In this way, after a brief encounter, Li Mu returned to his cell.
"Huh? Being taken away by that succubus, it's like nothing happened?"
As soon as he stepped into the cell, the voice of the lioness came from the depths, which seemed to be much softer.
Li Mu didn't dare to look at each other, smiled angrily, found a corner and sat down. Today's outing was over.
The prison only provides two meals a day.
One meal in the morning and one meal in the evening.
They go out to get meals in the morning and deliver meals to the cell in the evening.
